Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: full-flow Chinese WeChat mini-program design board for EXISTING FunBox 棋牌记分. CRITICAL reference: the attached image is the ACTUAL CURRENT PROJECT's 3x2 illustration atlas. It is a STYLE AND ASSET reference, not a page to edit. Use its EXACT recognizable illustration language in the mockup: soft rounded white playing cards with red and black A K Q suits, rounded GREEN-EDGED WHITE mahjong tiles with four green circles and red 中, shiny BLUE DIE, blue-edged +/- score tile with blue plus and coral minus, coral pawn or orange disc, white paper receipt with BLUE CHECK and score tile, blue and coral conversation bubbles. Preserve this friendly chunky soft plastic 3D rendering, proportions, palette and soft shadow. Do NOT substitute a new porcelain/jade illustration style. Do not add plants, leaves, photographic environments, green felt tables, rounded mahjong tabletops, stacks of coins, neon, gold, background still-life compositions or casino styling. GREEN is only a SMALL mahjong tile edge or semantic success indicator; never a large tabletop or primary background. Illustrations occupy about 15% of a page and never obstruct UI. Actual UI is flat clear airy, NOT entirely modeled in 3D. 
MATCH EXISTING PROJECT UI: background #f5f7fa with subtle #eaf2ff top-right glow; white cards radius16; primary #2d5bff, ink #172139, muted #7b879c, coral #ff765e; existing home scenario cards pastel mint #e8f7f1 and pastel peach #fff0ed. FunBox wordmark cobalt italic heavy. Rounded sans-serif PingFang SC/MiSans Chinese; bold readable page titles. Flat cobalt buttons with white text, muted pale-blue input backgrounds, line icons with rounded caps. Keep familiar existing layout hierarchy. All small control icons consistent cobalt/gray round-stroke 1.75px: edit pencil, scan frame, keyboard, copy, close, share. Large decorative icon illustrations match reference atlas; don't turn utility icons into huge 3D sculptures. Semantic positive scores green #278461, negative coral #ff765e; keep amounts same semantics.
CANVAS: landscape premium design review board, four equal large mobile screens side by side, each ~375x820 logical pixels tall, rendered at highest readable resolution about 2400x1600. Each screen with slim WeChat status/navigation capsule, no phone device case. Whitespace outside screens, modest board title and numbered captions. Minimize explanatory text. Screens occupy majority of canvas. Everything in Simplified Chinese, text exact and correctly written. Board header "FUNBOX / 原项目风格延续 / V3". Keep same across all boards. Tiny footer "静态概念稿 · 动效为示意 · 数据为样例". Do not add unrequested functionality, chats, avatars achievements, automatic game scoring, dice logic, payments, extra actions, simulated win rates, fake QR scan affordances.
PRODUCT INVARIANTS: four-person mahjong, payer enters manual points to up to three others and submits once, recipients do NOT enter duplicate earned points. Currency only in settlement/history, never during creation/waiting/active room. Name and password inline editable when creating, nickname normal input. Manual join requires 6-digit room CODE plus separate 4-6 digit PASSWORD plus nickname. Invite or scan join only nickname (no password). No automatic dice or seating shuffle. Seat marks 東南西北 from existing ordering; waiting uses actual app's TWO COLUMN CARD GRID not a game table. Use sample room 老友局 code682915 password666666; people 小林 阿杰 小雨 阿北. Sample points +48,+16,−24,−40 sum zero. Keep UI useful, not artsy marketing redesign. Do not draw motion paths across inputs; motion notes only below screens.
BOARD A title "01  首页与开局" subtitle "保留原有插画质感，统一图标与入口". FOUR screens:
SCREEN 1 HOME. Top FunBox / 棋牌记分, guest pill 游客. Hero headline 好友相聚，/ 每局都算数。 with 都算数 cobalt. On right SMALL existing generic hero group from atlas TOP LEFT (A hearts playing card, coral pawn, blue die and +/- tile), floating on page without scenery, not full-width artwork. Section 选择牌局 / 不同玩法，一样清楚. Two equally proportioned wide scenario cards exactly like current app: MINT card with text on LEFT 麻将记分 / 4 人牌局 · 给分与结算 / 已开放, on RIGHT actual atlas mahjong group four-circle green edge tile + red 中 + blue-edged score tile. PEACH card with text on LEFT 炸金花 / 轮流加注，实时看池 / 敬请期待, RIGHT actual atlas A K Q + orange chip group. Keep illustration sizes equal and modest, no tiny icon-on-left redesign. After cards blank breathing room and small 牌局服务正常 indicator. Bottom tabs 首页 / 我的 using existing simple home/person glyphs cobalt/gray. REMOVE THE ENTIRE 记分原则 module. No substitute explanatory rules or new module.
SCREEN 2 CREATE nav 麻将记分. Small FunBox / 棋牌记分 top line and guest. Hero 好友围桌，轻松记分 / 4 人牌局 · 给分清楚，散场好结算, small exact atlas mahjong group upper right. Segments 创建房间 active / 加入房间. White form card 开一桌 badge4人局; display large 老友局 with tiny pencil (inline editable text, NOT an extra labelled row box). hint 名称、密码均可点按修改. Field 你的昵称 / normal input 小林. Small lock row 房间密码 666666 pencil, NOT a separate heavy large password field. Pale blue note 先记分，散场时再设置金额. Blue 创建房间 CTA. Footer 创建后邀请好友，即可开始记分.
SCREEN 3 JOIN SCAN nav 麻将记分; same compact hero and segments 加入房间 selected. White scan card small 推荐方式 badge. Center 3D BLUE PHONE with WHITE SCAN FRAME, a small actual green-edged mahjong tile behind it, all modeled like atlas, no QR carved into tile. Title 扫一扫，加入好友牌局, desc 扫描房主出示的房间邀请码. Main 扫码加入, tiny 扫码后确认昵称即可入桌. Below white secondary row keyboard line icon 输入房间码加入 ›. Footer 游客也可加入，无需注册.
SCREEN 4 MANUAL JOIN SHEET nav same, dim join screen backdrop and open bottom sheet. Title 输入房间码加入, close x, desc 没有邀请码时，也可以手动加入. THREE clear SEPARATE inputs: 房间码 hint6位数字 [682915]; 房间密码 [666666]; 你的昵称 [小林]. These are ordinary continuous text inputs with pale blue background, NOT six standalone mahjong digit tiles, preserve existing usable form. Blue 加入牌局 CTA. Include tiny information 仅在本局内显示 near nickname. Visible all form controls no clipped content.
Below four screens compact coordinated icon samples labelled 麻将 / 扑克 / 扫码 / 记分 / 结算 / 战绩 using exact atlas-like 3D mini illustrations; small line "插画统一圆润立体质感；操作图标保持轻量". No generic ceramic numbered tiles or full green table.
Short per-screen captions: 首页去掉记分规则; 原位编辑保留; 扫码入口轻反馈; 表单完整保留.

BOARD B title "02  入桌与实时记分" subtitle "沿用白色卡片布局，用轻量反馈增强互动". FOUR screens:
SCREEN 1 INVITE ACCEPT nav 麻将牌局. Small icon TWO BLUE LINK/INVITATION cards in atlas rounded soft3D style, headline 牌友都在，等你入座 and kicker 好友邀请你加入牌局. White room preview card has actual atlas mahjong illustration small LEFT and 老友局 / 麻将记分 · 4人牌局 / 等待加入 RIGHT. Pale blue verified row with check 邀请已验证，无需房间码和密码. Nickname section 怎么称呼你？ input 小林, helper 仅在本局内显示，可修改. Blue 确认加入. Footer 扫码与邀请链接，均可快捷入桌 and subtle 返回首页. No password.
SCREEN 2 WAITING ROOM HOST nav 麻将牌局. Existing white header card 牌桌·682915 / 老友局, green dot 实时同步, 当前人数3/4, 等待开始 badge. White invitation card title 扫码或转发加入, helper 填写昵称即可加入. On left pale blue room code682915 and 复制房间码; password row 房间密码666666; on right standard square black-white QR on clean white background, 点击放大. Blue 发送邀请给牌友. Section 围桌牌友 /3/4人 then TWO-COLUMN GRID of FOUR small WHITE participant cards: 東 小林 我/房主·已入座; 南 阿杰/牌友·已入座; 西 小雨/牌友·已入座; 北 等牌友入座/位置还热着 (dashed outline empty card). Seat badges are tiny pale BLUE flat tiles with cobalt characters, NOT four physical mahjong placed around a green table. Bottom disabled 等待牌友加入. Four grid cards fit comfortably. Caption 入座时座位卡轻翻，保留原有网格 240ms.
SCREEN 3 QR ENLARGEMENT. Same waiting page dim backdrop, centered WHITE rounded modal with handle/close, title 邀请二维码, large STANDARD black-white illustrative QR, under text 老友局 ·682915 / 再次点击二维码收起. A small TWO blue3D invitation tiles motif at top outside QR quiet zone, matching atlas. No giant Mahjong frame. QR itself plain undistorted with white quiet zone. Caption 邀请卡轻放大，二维码保持清晰.
SCREEN 4 ACTIVE ROOM nav 麻将牌局. White existing room header 牌桌·682915 / 老友局; green 实时同步; 当前人数4/4 and 牌局进行中 badge. White scoreboard title 牌桌积分榜 / 实时比分. Four compact HORIZONTAL LIST rows, each rank1/2/3/4 then small pale blue seat mark then name and right-aligned points: 東 小林 我 +48; 南 阿杰 +16; 西 小雨 −24; 北 阿北 −40. Self row pale blue. Below WHITE card 这局怎么给 / 赢家无需填写, helper 填好这局要给的分，一次交账. Three recipient rows 阿杰 [8]分, 小雨 [0]分, 阿北 [0]分. 本次给出8分 and blue 确认给分. Next white 牌桌记事 / 最近2笔 with transaction-only lines 小雨 → 小林 12分; 阿北 → 阿杰 8分; no chat or '+记一条'. Bottom outlined 散场结算. Make active screen tall enough to show all information with compact comfortable rows. No currency. No flying sticks across inputs.
BOTTOM review strip: small feedback vignette in actual atlas style BLUE PLUS / CORAL MINUS tile + check mark next to text 给分成功 / 已同步, then thin motion frames labels 成功后轻弹记分牌 · 280ms and 分数短暂滚动 · 输入区域保持稳定. Another small pastel blue optional banner 登录后记录本局战绩 / 登录并绑定, label 游客提示保留. Keep bottom strip secondary and uncluttered, no physical table.

BOARD C title "03  结算与个人战绩" subtitle "沿用现有账单与记录插画，信息清楚、反馈克制". FOUR screens:
SCREEN 1 SETTLEMENT CONFIRMATION. Nav 麻将牌局. Dimmed active room behind a tall WHITE rounded bottom sheet, handle. Title 确认结算, desc 请核对每名玩家的分数与预计金额. Row 每分金额 with [¥ 1] 元/分. Compact table headers 牌友 / 当前分数 / 预计金额 and four rows 小林 +48 +¥48.00; 阿杰 +16 +¥16.00; 小雨 −24 −¥24.00; 阿北 −40 −¥40.00. Positive all green, negative coral. Coral pale warning strip 结算后不可修改，请再次确认。Main button coral #ff765e 确认并结算 (existing danger action), secondary light button 取消. Small actual atlas white receipt + blue check motif near title without obstructing content. Keep amounts in this screen and later only.
SCREEN 2 SETTLED RESULT. Nav 麻将牌局. Small header room card 老友局 / 已结算. Hero has SMALL exact existing atlas receipt with blue check and blue-edged +/- score tile (bottom right of reference) occupying 100 logical pixels centered, NOT a row of large physical mahjong tiles. Headline 这桌，散场了 / 输赢已理清, subtitle 最终输赢与转账如下. White results card four readable rows name / points / amounts 小林 +48分 +¥48.00; 阿杰 +16分 +¥16.00; 小雨 −24分 −¥24.00; 阿北 −40分 −¥40.00. White 转账建议 card three exact rows 小雨 → 小林 ¥24.00; 阿北 → 小林 ¥24.00; 阿北 → 阿杰 ¥16.00. No payment buttons, add tiny label 仅为转账建议. Secondary 返回首页.
SCREEN 3 HISTORY nav 最近牌局. Header FunBox / 牌局记录, title 最近牌局 and desc 查看本人参与的已结算牌局. SMALL atlas receipt-blue-check illustration upper right. Filter chips 全部 selected / 近7天 / 近30天 / 近90天. Three visible plain white record cards: 老友局 麻将 / +48分 +¥48.00; 周末小聚 麻将 / −12分 −¥12.00; 同事局 麻将 / +6分 +¥6.00. Each has participants row 参与者 小林、阿杰、小雨、阿北 and 结算时间2026-10-30 14:30 (other two dates10-28 and10-25). Positive green and negative coral. These are plain information cards NO chevrons, no detail links, no new stats or achievements. Bottom 第1/3页·共12场, 上一页 disabled / 下一页 blue. Scrolling shown by normal card list, not a real mahjong tile album.
SCREEN 4 MY PROFILE nav 我的 with FunBox. Hero 每一局，都有记录。 with 都有 cobalt; original TOP LEFT atlas generic group small right (poker A, pawn, blue die, scoring +/- tile), preserve same visual identity as home. Identity white card round blue avatar 林, 小林 and masked account 138****1024, chevron. White 最近牌局 row with desc 按时间回看参与者和输赢 and exact atlas blue-check receipt illustration RIGHT, chevron. White 功能反馈 row with desc 上传截图，告诉我们你的问题 and exact atlas blue+coral conversation bubble illustration RIGHT, chevron. Tiny footer 开心玩，清楚记。No fabricated feature list. Bottom tabs 首页 / 我的 selected.
BOTTOM supporting state strip FOUR small quiet white state cards with matching soft 3D mini icon style and concise text: 正在同步牌局 (blue +/- tile pulse); 暂无牌局记录 (blank receipt icon); 无法打开牌局 / 重新加载 (coral ! disc with blue reload arrow); 牌局已取消 / 返回首页 (muted score tile). Little note 离线时保留已有分数，显示重连. Per-screen captions 确认信息不被动效打断; 账单轻展开; 记录卡淡入; 延续个人中心原布局.
